goal: Create a single self-contained index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913). Include: 1) Responsive full-window <canvas id="space-canvas"> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling. 2) Central glowing star using createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse. 3) At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, colors, at least 3 moons/satellites, and fading orbital trails. 4) Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars. 5) Interactive glassmorphism HUD overlay with Play/Pause button (#toggle-play, showing "Pause"/"Play"), Trails ON/OFF button (#toggle-trails, showing "Trails: ON"/"Trails: OFF"), Reset button (#reset-btn), speed range slider (<input id="speed-slider" type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">) with live multiplier readout (#speed-value showing e.g. "1.0x"), and live FPS (#fps), simulation time in seconds (#sim-time), and active burst particle count (#particle-count, "0" initially and on reset). 6) Clicking anywhere on the canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out. Keep everything self-contained in index.html with zero external dependencies and valid JavaScript syntax.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html with zero external dependencies and valid inline JavaScript syntax.
Full-viewport <canvas id='space-canvas'> in #060913 dark space using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
Central glowing star rendered with createRadialGradient and an animated corona pulse.
At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, and colors.
Fading orbital trails rendered behind orbiting planets.
Twinkling background starfield containing at least 150 stars.
Glassmorphism HUD overlay with Play/Pause button #toggle-play that toggles simulation pause state.
HUD Trails button #toggle-trails toggles orbital trail rendering ON and OFF.
HUD Reset button #reset-btn resets simulation time and clears burst particles.
HUD speed slider <input id='speed-slider' type='range' min='0.2' max='3.0' step='0.1' value='1.0'> updates #speed-value readout.
HUD displays live FPS in #fps, simulation time in #sim-time, and active burst count in #particle-count.
Clicking #space-canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
